The schema defines two core models: `Entity` and `EntityEdge`. Entities are resolved via normalized names and type, ensuring uniqueness under a (type, normalized_name, sport) tuple. Relations are typed, directed, and carry provenance, enabling Bayesian inference in GSI and state transitions in GSE. Temporal validity allows historical tracking without deletion. The shallow graph structure justifies relational storage over graph databases. Provenance and confidence fields allow risk mitigation against fabricated relationships. Recursive CTEs enable efficient traversal of up to four hops, aligning with the doctrine’s minimal graph depth. The system avoids nulls in critical fields like `sport` to maintain unique constraints in Postgres.
